name: data_scripts_tool
description: Data tool - Scripts tool to manage custom code scripts. Register, apply, update, and remove scripts at the site or page level, and read or write freeform head/footer custom code blocks.

label.description: Label echoed in the response for this action item. It does not select which action runs.

script_id.description: ID of the registered script to apply.

location.description: Where to place the script: 'header' or 'footer'.

version.description: Version of the script to apply.

attributes.description: Optional HTML attributes applied to the script element, as a flat map of attribute name to string value. Keys are attribute names such as 'async', 'defer', 'type', 'crossorigin', or 'data-*'. Values must be strings (e.g., { async: 'true', type: 'module', 'data-id': 'analytics' }); booleans and numbers are not accepted.

add_page_script.description: Apply a single registered script to a page without affecting other applied scripts. The script must already be registered (use register_inline_script or register_hosted_script first). If a script with the same ID is already applied, it will be updated with the new location, version, and attributes.

anyOf.description: Run add_page_script: Apply a single registered script to a page without affecting other applied scripts. The script must already be registered (use register_inline_script or register_hosted_script first). If a script with the same ID is already applied, it will be updated with the new location, version, and attributes.

script_id.description: ID of the registered script to apply.

location.description: Where to place the script: 'header' or 'footer'.

version.description: Version of the script to apply.

attributes.description: Optional HTML attributes applied to the script element, as a flat map of attribute name to string value. add_site_script.description: Apply a single registered script to a site without affecting other applied scripts. The script must already be registered (use register_inline_script or register_hosted_script first). If a script with the same ID is already applied, it will be updated with the new location, version, and attributes.

anyOf.description: Run add_site_script: Apply a single registered script to a site without affecting other applied scripts. The script must already be registered (use register_inline_script or register_hosted_script first). If a script with the same ID is already applied, it will be updated with the new location, version, and attributes.

clear_page_scripts.description: Remove all scripts applied to a page. This does not delete the scripts from the site's registry — they remain registered and can be re-applied later using add_page_script or set_page_scripts.

anyOf.description: Run clear_page_scripts: Remove all scripts applied to a page. This does not delete the scripts from the site's registry — they remain registered and can be re-applied later using add_page_script or set_page_scripts.

clear_site_scripts.description: Remove all scripts applied to a site. This does not delete the scripts from the site's registry — they remain registered and can be re-applied later using add_site_script or set_site_scripts.

anyOf.description: Run clear_site_scripts: Remove all scripts applied to a site. This does not delete the scripts from the site's registry — they remain registered and can be re-applied later using add_site_script or set_site_scripts.

script_id.description: The registered script ID to delete.

delete_registered_script.description: Delete a registered script from a site by script ID. Destructive and irreversible — the script and all of its versions are removed. Returns the API response on success.

anyOf.description: Run delete_registered_script: Delete a registered script from a site by script ID. Destructive and irreversible — the script and all of its versions are removed. Returns the API response on success.

location.description: Optional: 'head' or 'footer'. Omit to fetch both blocks.

localeId.description: Optional locale ID. Must equal the site's primary locale if provided.

get_page_freeform_code.description: Read freeform head/footer custom code blocks on a page. Omit location to fetch both blocks; pass 'head' or 'footer' to fetch one. localeId is optional and, if provided, must be the site's primary locale (page-level freeform code is single-locale today).

anyOf.description: Run get_page_freeform_code: Read freeform head/footer custom code blocks on a page. Omit location to fetch both blocks; pass 'head' or 'footer' to fetch one. localeId is optional and, if provided, must be the site's primary locale (page-level freeform code is single-locale today).

get_page_scripts.description: Get all scripts currently applied to a specific page. Returns the list of applied scripts with their IDs, locations (header/footer), versions, and attributes.

anyOf.description: Run get_page_scripts: Get all scripts currently applied to a specific page. Returns the list of applied scripts with their IDs, locations (header/footer), versions, and attributes.

version.description: Optional SemVer version string. When omitted, returns the most recently created version.

get_registered_script.description: Get a single registered script for a site by script ID. When 'version' is omitted, returns the most recently created version of the script. Returns the script metadata including its ID, display name, version, and hosting information.

anyOf.description: Run get_registered_script: Get a single registered script for a site by script ID. When 'version' is omitted, returns the most recently created version of the script. Returns the script metadata including its ID, display name, version, and hosting information.

get_registered_scripts.description: List all scripts registered for a site. A site can have up to 800 registered scripts. Returns script IDs, display names, versions, and hosting information. Registered scripts can be applied to the site or individual pages using add_site_script or add_page_script.

anyOf.description: Run get_registered_scripts: List all scripts registered for a site. A site can have up to 800 registered scripts. Returns script IDs, display names, versions, and hosting information. Registered scripts can be applied to the site or individual pages using add_site_script or add_page_script.

location.description: Optional: 'head' or 'footer'. Omit to fetch both blocks.

get_site_freeform_code.description: Read freeform head/footer custom code blocks on a site. These are raw code blocks (distinct from registered scripts). Omit location to fetch both blocks; pass 'head' or 'footer' to fetch one.

anyOf.description: Run get_site_freeform_code: Read freeform head/footer custom code blocks on a site. These are raw code blocks (distinct from registered scripts). Omit location to fetch both blocks; pass 'head' or 'footer' to fetch one.

get_site_scripts.description: Get all scripts currently applied to a site. Returns the list of applied scripts with their IDs, locations (header/footer), versions, and attributes. Use this to see what scripts are active on the site before adding or removing scripts.

anyOf.description: Run get_site_scripts: Get all scripts currently applied to a site. Returns the list of applied scripts with their IDs, locations (header/footer), versions, and attributes. Use this to see what scripts are active on the site before adding or removing scripts.

site_id.description: The site ID to register the script for.

hosted_location.description: URI of the externally hosted script.

integrity_hash.description: Sub-Resource Integrity (SRI) hash for the hosted script.

display_name.description: User-facing name for the script. 1-50 alphanumeric characters.

can_copy.description: Whether the script can be copied on site duplication. Defaults to true.

register_hosted_script.description: Register an externally hosted script for a site without applying it to any page or the site. Returns the registered script metadata including its ID. To apply the script after registering, use add_site_script or add_page_script.

anyOf.description: Run register_hosted_script: Register an externally hosted script for a site without applying it to any page or the site. Returns the registered script metadata including its ID. To apply the script after registering, use add_site_script or add_page_script.

site_id.description: The site ID to register the script for.

source_code.description: Inline script source code hosted by Webflow. Max 2000 characters.

display_name.description: User-facing name for the script. 1-50 alphanumeric characters.

can_copy.description: Whether the script can be copied on site duplication. Defaults to true.

register_inline_script.description: Register an inline script for a site without applying it to any page or the site. Inline scripts are hosted by Webflow and limited to 2000 characters. Returns the registered script metadata including its ID. To apply the script after registering, use add_site_script or add_page_script.

anyOf.description: Run register_inline_script: Register an inline script for a site without applying it to any page or the site. Inline scripts are hosted by Webflow and limited to 2000 characters. Returns the registered script metadata including its ID. To apply the script after registering, use add_site_script or add_page_script.

script_id.description: ID of the script to remove from the page.

remove_page_script.description: Remove a single script from a page without affecting other applied scripts. If the script is not currently applied, returns the current list unchanged. If removing the last script, all scripts are cleared from the page.

anyOf.description: Run remove_page_script: Remove a single script from a page without affecting other applied scripts. If the script is not currently applied, returns the current list unchanged. If removing the last script, all scripts are cleared from the page.

script_id.description: ID of the script to remove from the site.

remove_site_script.description: Remove a single script from a site without affecting other applied scripts. If the script is not currently applied, returns the current list unchanged. If removing the last script, all scripts are cleared from the site.

anyOf.description: Run remove_site_script: Remove a single script from a site without affecting other applied scripts. If the script is not currently applied, returns the current list unchanged. If removing the last script, all scripts are cleared from the site.

content.description: The full raw code to store in the block.

localeId.description: Optional locale ID. Must equal the site's primary locale if provided.

set_page_freeform_code.description: Write the freeform head or footer custom code block on a page. Replaces the full content for the chosen location. localeId is optional and, if provided, must be the site's primary locale (page-level freeform code is single-locale today). Folder-type pages do not support freeform code and will return an error.

anyOf.description: Run set_page_freeform_code: Write the freeform head or footer custom code block on a page. Replaces the full content for the chosen location. localeId is optional and, if provided, must be the site's primary locale (page-level freeform code is single-locale today). Folder-type pages do not support freeform code and will return an error.

version.description: Version of the script to apply.

attributes.description: Optional HTML attributes applied to the script element, as a flat map of attribute name to string value. Keys are attribute names such as 'async', 'defer', 'type', 'crossorigin', or 'data-*'. Values must be strings (e.g., { async: 'true', type: 'module', 'data-id': 'analytics' }); booleans and numbers are not accepted.

scripts.description: Complete list of scripts to apply. Replaces all existing applied scripts.

set_page_scripts.description: Replace ALL scripts applied to a page with the provided list. WARNING: This replaces the entire list of applied scripts — any scripts not included will be removed. For adding or removing a single script, use add_page_script or remove_page_script instead. Scripts must be registered before they can be applied.

anyOf.description: Run set_page_scripts: Replace ALL scripts applied to a page with the provided list. WARNING: This replaces the entire list of applied scripts — any scripts not included will be removed. For adding or removing a single script, use add_page_script or remove_page_script instead. Scripts must be registered before they can be applied.

content.description: The full raw code to store in the block.

set_site_freeform_code.description: Write the freeform head or footer custom code block on a site. Replaces the full content for the chosen location. content must be within the site's custom-code character limit.

anyOf.description: Run set_site_freeform_code: Write the freeform head or footer custom code block on a site. Replaces the full content for the chosen location. content must be within the site's custom-code character limit.

script_id.description: The registered script ID to update.

display_name.description: User-facing name for the script. 1-50 alphanumeric characters.

source_code.description: Inline script source code (for inline scripts). Max 2000 characters.

hosted_location.description: URI of the externally hosted script (for hosted scripts).

integrity_hash.description: Sub-Resource Integrity (SRI) hash for the hosted script. Required when updating 'hosted_location'.

can_copy.description: Whether the script can be copied on site duplication.

update_registered_script.description: Update a single registered script for a site. Supports updating display name, inline source code (for inline scripts), hosted location + integrity hash (for hosted scripts), version, and canCopy. All body fields are optional — only the provided fields are updated.

anyOf.description: Run update_registered_script: Update a single registered script for a site. Supports updating display name, inline source code (for inline scripts), hosted location + integrity hash (for hosted scripts), version, and canCopy. All body fields are optional — only the provided fields are updated.

actions.description: Actions to execute sequentially. Each array item must include label and exactly one action property: add_page_script, add_site_script, clear_page_scripts, clear_site_scripts, delete_registered_script, get_page_freeform_code, get_page_scripts, get_registered_script, get_registered_scripts, get_site_freeform_code, get_site_scripts, register_hosted_script, register_inline_script, remove_page_script, remove_site_script, set_page_freeform_code, set_page_scripts, set_site_freeform_code, set_site_scripts, update_registered_script.

context.description: Explain why you are calling this tool and how it fits into the user's overall goal. This parameter is used for analytics and user intent tracking. YOU MUST provide 15-25 words (count carefully). NEVER use first person ('I', 'we', 'you') - maintain third-person perspective. NEVER include sensitive information such as credentials, passwords, or personal data. Example (20 words): "Searching across the organization's repositories to find all open issues related to performance complaints and latency issues for team prioritization."
